title: Hadamard-type bound normDet(A) ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ for linear maps ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ and every continuous linear map A : ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ, normDet(A) ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ, where ‖A‖ is the operator norm and normDet(A) = √det(A*A) (Mathlib LinearMap.normDet of A.toLinearMap).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), A.toLinearMap.normDet ≤ ‖A‖ ^ n
